results.title: Technological Advance - an overview | ScienceDirect Topics
results.content: Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), developed by Google, are designed specifically for tensor operations and neural network computations, offering accelerated performance and energy efficiency for large-scale AI tasks. Interdisciplinary integration characterizes contemporary computer science, with AI research leveraging concepts from graph theory, game theory, cognitive science, and physics to develop more powerful algorithms and hardware acceleration technologies, including GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, ASICs, and quantum computing. Networking and security technologies have evolved to support high-speed, distributed, and secure computing environments, while emerging trends like blockchain integration, augmented reality, and edge AI promise to reshape applications and societal interactions. Various hardware acceleration technologies, including GPUs, TPUs, FPGAs, application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), and quantum computing, have been developed to overcome the constraints of traditional architectures and augment computational capabilities and efficiency . Despite the existing technological advances of the data processing paradigms (e.g., MapReduce and cloud computing platforms), large-scale, reliable system-level software for big data applications is yet to become commonplace.
